metaTitle: Custom American Apparel Apparel | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom American Apparel apparel for your team. Soft triblend tees and more. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: American Apparel blank apparel is known for its soft, ring-spun fabrics and consistent sizing, making it a top choice for custom printing. Whether you need uniform tees for a retail crew or promotional shirts for a campus event, the triblend material offers a vintage feel that holds up to screen printing and embroidery. Ordering in bulk from this brand ensures your logo looks sharp on a reliable, everyday garment.
